definitions.explanation: A general term encompassing both pottery (earthenware/stoneware) and porcelain. Refers to objects made from clay that are shaped and fired in a kiln.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{陶磁器|とうじき}は{世界的|せかいてき}に{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
{美術館|びじゅつかん}で{古|ふる}い{陶磁器|とうじき}の{展示|てんじ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw an exhibition of old ceramics at the art museum.

examples.japanese: {有田焼|ありたやき}は{日本|にほん}を{代表|だいひょう}する{陶磁器|とうじき}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Arita ware is one of the most representative ceramics of Japan.

notes:
USAGE:
A comprehensive term covering both {陶器|とうき} (pottery, earthenware) and {磁器|じき} (porcelain). Japan has a long tradition of ceramic arts, with famous regional styles such as {有田焼|ありたやき}, {瀬戸焼|せとやき}, and {益子焼|ましこやき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陶磁器|とうじき}の{産地|さんち} (ceramics production area)
- {陶磁器|とうじき}{市|いち} (ceramics market/fair)
- {陶磁器|とうじき}{美術館|びじゅつかん} (ceramics museum)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {陶器|とうき}: pottery, earthenware (lower firing temperature)
- {磁器|じき}: porcelain (higher firing temperature, translucent)
- {焼|や}き{物|もの}: pottery, ceramics (more casual term)
